selectedFamily.description: Generate one root-position companion from an existing slash-bass min7 raw candidate.

evidence.selectionRule: A generator bug affecting all observed basic m7 misses has priority over a new altered-dominant vocabulary.

grammar.output: ChordSymbol(same root, quality=min7, same tensions, bass omitted)
preconditions: source candidate is already present in the raw phase4-v1 candidate pool
all four min7 core pitch classes have source note-instance support
the root-position canonical identity is not already present
forbidden: using Gold labels as generator input

runtime.implementationConstraint: single bounded pass over pre-sorted raw candidates

counterfactualRisk.expected: Generated root-position companion retains the source raw score and may tie with its slash source.
counterfactualRisk.scorePolicy: Do not invent a bonus or mix a new score scale.

notSelected.reason: It is a separate alteration-vocabulary gap; the preregistered generator-bug priority applies first.
It spans several quality families and widens the first experiment beyond one family.
Same mechanism but a distinct extension family; defer until the basic m7 bounded experiment is measured.

rollback.action: Remove the evaluation-only Shadow generator and reports; no Vault migration or Product rollback is required.
